evidence: Swap test fails: a GP surgery appointment booker or a library meeting-room booker could take the frame unchanged (pale grey-green ground, white bordered cards, one green filled button, 4 px boxes, bold-sans 'There is a problem' summary, '1. When 2. ... 3. ...' text stepper); only the words would change. With the name hidden, only the copy ('the gate checks the reference and the vehicle', 'Permit number') says this is a tip.

Category-guess test fails: the predicted default for a UK council transactional service (GOV.UK-like single column, green/neutral palette, error summary box, check-your-answers card, plain reference panel) matches every identity-carrying element; the masthead is a small bin outline icon plus 'Dunmore District Council' in bold body text, no designed mark.

Similar-prompt test fails: 'book a 30-minute slot at a council swimming pool' would land on the same time-button grid with 'Few left'/'Full' tags, the same Morning/Afternoon split, the same summary card and the same reference card on the done page.

Elements bound to the product are copy-level only: the vehicle segmented control with a permit field, waste checkboxes with rubble/mattress limits, the 'At the centre' card. They are content, not identity-carrying visual decisions.

unfinished: Identity is only the council name in bold body text beside a small bin outline icon (all screens, masthead).
No focal point on the done page: the reference DR-204117 is set at roughly heading size inside a full-width white card with an empty right half (done/default 1280-light).

Half-empty columns at wide widths: the slot grid stops at about 816 px and the forms at about 707 px inside a 1184 px content area, while the summary, error and opening-days cards stretch the full width, so the right third of every screen is empty and edges do not line up (root/slot-chosen 1280, vehicle 1280, confirm 1280).
Short pages leave an empty band of page ground below the footer (done/default and done/cancelled 1280-light).
Headings differ from body mostly by size and weight; there is no typographic moment anywhere (all screens).
Sections that are only a heading and a list: 'What are you bringing?' is seven identical bordered rows; the confirm page is four stacked inputs.
